It explicitly attempts a close replication of Chartrand and Bargh Experiment 1. The reference list identifies Förster, N. (2022, November 3), The Chameleon Effect: A Replication Study, OSF, with project URL https://osf.io/7weum/?view_only=1fe5c59031ea4805989d52f3e24ed5a2. This supports project identity and primary-report status. Title-page byline is absent; the supplied three-author attribution and DOI cannot be independently confirmed from this parse. Statement of independent work is dated 30.01.2023: this is a later thesis report associated with the 2022 project. Source header: DOCX, paragraphs retained; page breaks not reconstructed. No PDF supplied; locator p.32 cannot be visually confirmed. Page ranges below follow the table of contents only.

Both assigned inputs give only Experiment 1, replication p.32, and no outcome description or replication study identifier. General Discussion spans TOC pp.30–33 and discusses multiple outcomes and analyses; neither audit_id can be uniquely assigned. Main analysis (§5.4, TOC pp.21–27): explicit analytic N=14 participants passing exclusions, with baseline covariates. Smiling interaction: η2=.453, F(1,11)=9.10, p=.012. Foot-shaking interaction: η2=.171, F(1,10)=2.06, p=.182. Face-rubbing interaction: η2=.037, F(1,10)=0.39, p=.547. Printed metric is η2; partial eta-squared identity is not inferred. Sensitivity excluding participant 23 (§5.4.2): face-rubbing interaction η2=.045, F(1,9)=0.42, p=.532; foot-shaking interaction η2=.177, F(1,9)=1.94, p=.197. No analytic N derived from df. Exploratory analysis (§5.9, TOC p.29): explicit N=31 participants including those suspecting confederates; smiling η2=.160, F(1,28)=5.32, p=.029; foot shaking η2=.229, F(1,27)=8.00, p=.009; face rubbing η2≤.001, F(1,27)≤0.01, p=.964; joint behavioral interaction η2=.234, F(1,27)=8.23, p=.008. Nonparametric (§5.7, TOC p.28): smiling ps=.023, foot shaking ps≤.040, face rubbing ps≥.242; separate tests, not paired with ANOVA η2. Generic recruitment N=35 is not analytic N. §4.4 reports three technical-recording exclusions, one real-purpose guess and nineteen suspicions of confederates; their overlap is not assumed and no exclusion arithmetic is performed. No group sums or transformations performed. Overall author verdict is failed; smiling-specific verdict is successful; behavioral outcomes vary by analysis. All numbers and verdicts above are candidates, not completed row-specific values. N candidates are retained for parent field-scope review only.
